```rca
 "causal_chain": ["Single Stroller sales jump on a few SKUs", "Metro stores lift while Regional falls", "Units up at full price, less promotion", "Brand grows while the market shrinks", "Revenue +6.9% YoY, share +1.2 pts"],

                  {"label": "Single Stroller revenue YoY", "value": "+34.1%"},
                  {"label": "Metro revenue YoY (Regional -21%)", "value": "+22%"},
                  {"label": "Full-price revenue YoY (promo -32.8%)", "value": "+15%"},
                  {"label": "Margin change vs LY", "value": "+3 pts"}],
 "hypotheses": [{"hypothesis": "Market-wide growth", "verdict": "RULED_OUT", "evidence": "Brand +6.9% vs market -5.2%; AUD 111K of the gain is the brand's own"},
                {"hypothesis": "Volume, not price", "verdict": "CONFIRMED", "evidence": "Units +9.6%, ASP -2.4%; volume effect AUD 87.7K"},
                {"hypothesis": "Single Stroller class", "verdict": "CONFIRMED", "evidence": "+34.1%, 117% of growth; other classes -1.6%"},
                {"hypothesis": "Metro region", "verdict": "CONFIRMED", "evidence": "Metro +22% (AUD +122K); Regional -21% (AUD -55K)"},
                {"hypothesis": "Full-price selling", "verdict": "CONFIRMED", "evidence": "Full price +15%; promo -32.8%; promo mix -6.3 pts"},
                {"hypothesis": "Supply", "verdict": "RULED_OUT", "evidence": "DIFOT 85.7% vs 86.6% before; out of stock 1.6% vs market 1.9%"},
                {"hypothesis": "Competitor price", "verdict": "INCONCLUSIVE", "evidence": "No competitor price data in either year"}],
 "ruled_out": ["Market tailwind - the market fell 5.2% while the brand grew", "Price increase - ASP fell 2.4%; growth is units", "Supply - DIFOT steady, stock availability better than market"],
 "impact": "AUD +63.4K (+6.9%) YoY and AUD +112K (+12.9%) vs prior 28 days; margin 38% (+3 pts). Risk: Regional -21%, Double Stroller -12.6%, Capsule -10.1%.",
 "actions": [{"owner": "Category", "action": "Find out why Single Stroller SKUs 14, 9 and 15 jumped in Metro and protect their ranging"},
             {"owner": "Buying", "action": "Size forward orders for the fast-growing Single Stroller SKUs and Accessories 2"},
             {"owner": "Category", "action": "Investigate the Regional decline (-21%) and the Double Stroller 2 and Capsule 6 falls"},

 "learning": "The brand is growing against a falling market, so check whether the Metro full-price gains hold or are only moving sales away from Regional."}
```

### What is happening
In the 28 days to 7 May 2026, Mountain Buggy took **AUD 978K**. That is **+6.9%** on last year (AUD +63.4K) and **+12.9%** on the prior 28 days. The rest of the Prams & Strollers market fell **5.2%**, so the brand's share rose from 11.1% to 12.3%. This growth is specific to Mountain Buggy, not a market trend. It is real sales growth: the demand view matches the tills exactly.

The growth comes from selling more units. Units rose 9.6% while the average price fell 2.4%. Sales also moved towards full price: discounting fell from 4.1% to 2.6%, and margin rose 3 points to 38%. Three things carry it:
- **Single Strollers** grew 34.1% (AUD +74K). That class alone is more than the brand's whole gain; the other classes fell 1.6% together. A few SKUs did most of the lifting: Single Stroller 14, 9 and 15, plus Accessories 2, each grew several times over.
- **Metro stores** grew 22% (AUD +122K). Regional stores fell 21% (AUD -55K), which takes back almost half of the Metro gain.
- **Full-price sales** grew 15%, while promotional sales fell 32.8%.

The weekly figures turned above last year from mid-April, at +10.7% and +12.1% in the last two full weeks.



### What we tested
| Hypothesis | Evidence | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Whole market growing | Brand +6.9% vs market -5.2%; AUD 111K of the gain is the brand's own | Ruled out |
| Volume vs price | Units +9.6%, average price -2.4% | Confirmed: volume |
| Class | Single Stroller +34.1%; other classes -1.6% | Confirmed |
| Region | Metro +22%, Regional -21% | Confirmed |
| Promotion | Full price +15%, on promotion -32.8% | Confirmed |
| SKU | Accessories 2 +536%, Single Stroller 14 +216%, Single Stroller 9 +443%; other SKUs +3.3% | Confirmed: a few SKUs |
| Supply | Supplier on-time-in-full deliveries 85.7% vs 86.6% before; out of stock 1.6% vs market 1.9% | Ruled out |
| Competitor price | No competitor price data in either year | Inconclusive |

### What to do
- **Category:** find out why Single Stroller 14, 9 and 15 took off in Metro stores (new range, placement or a model change), and keep them well ranged.
- **Buying:** size forward orders for these SKUs and Accessories 2 to match the higher sales rate.
- **Category:** look into the Regional decline and the falls in Double Stroller 2 (-75.8%) and Capsule Stroller 6 (-62%). They are holding back the net gain.
- **Data:** get competitor price data for Mountain Buggy so its price position can be tested.

Confidence is medium because there is no competitor price data, so we can't say whether pricing against rivals played a part.
